description: Remove the members whose email domain is outside the organization's verified domains and turn `enforce_verified_domains` on, in one transaction Remove the members whose email domain is outside the organization's verified domains and turn `enforce_verified_domains` on, in one transaction. POST /api/organizations/{id}/r…
context:
POST /api/organizations/{id}/remove_blocked_members_and_enforce_verified_domains/
Remove the members whose email domain is outside the organization's verified domains and turn `enforce_verified_domains` on, in one transaction. Owners are never removed; they keep gated access and can disable the setting themselves. Admin only. Use this only when the caller has confirmed the removals. To turn the setting on without touching memberships, PATCH `enforce_verified_domains` on the organization instead.
Required: id (path) — A UUID string identifying this organization.
